scope: Five current pure-host library tests; OS-neutral checked shapes, budgets and readback validation. Not UI, JIT, GPU or transitive unsafe certification.
linux_limit: tiny-xlib 0.2.5 XLIB eager constructor calls Xlib::load and dlopen before test entry; pinned Miri does not support Linux dlopen.
reopen: Any changed or new production source or dependency resolution requires review. New OS-specific authored code invalidates cross-host coverage unless separately qualified. Required CI must execute canonical macOS Miri; a Linux local all result cannot substitute.
